sentences.text:
Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Manoj Kumar Ohri

The nominal roll on record dated 05.08.2025 reflects that the appellant paid the fine imposed upon him by the Trial Court on 19.04.2022, completed his sentence, and was accordingly released from jail on 08.06.2022.
However, as noted in the order dated 13.07.2022, the appellant wishes to press the present appeal on merits.

2. Considering that the present appeal arises out of a conviction under Sections 376(2)(f)/174A IPC,
issue notice to the victim, through all permissible modes, returnable on 01.09.2025.

3. The I.O./SHO shall also inform the complainant about her right to free legal aid/representation in accordance with the decision of the Supreme Court in Jagjeet Singh v. Ashish Mishra, reported as (2022) 9 SCC 321, and if required, shall assist the prosecutrix in approaching the Secretary, Delhi High Court Legal Services Committee, who may appoint a panel counsel, if This is a digitally signed order.
